title: 就业数据强劲：美联储却看通胀？，经济学家市场反应过头
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: What's your first take this morning? My first take is the strong data seems to be correcting for some of the seasonal issues that we've seen.
segments.zh: 今早您的第一反应是什么？我的第一反应是强劲的数据似乎正在修正我们之前看到的一些季节性因素。

segments.en: The prior two months saw substantial declines in leisure and hospitality.
segments.zh: 前两个月休闲和酒店业出现了大幅下滑。

segments.en: That has just been corrected in July. It was minus 20 in June.
segments.zh: 7月份刚刚修正了这一点。6月份是负20。

segments.en: It was minus 50. So the fact that it bounced back doesn't really imply that much happening under the surface.
segments.zh: 之前是负50。所以反弹的事实并不真正意味着表面之下发生了很多事情。

segments.en: The unemployment rate did end up taking up a little bit. Nearly rounding up to 4.2.
segments.zh: 失业率确实略有上升，几乎四舍五入到4.2。

segments.en: So they barely made it to 0.3. It was a skinny 0.3.
segments.zh: 所以勉强达到0.3，是一个微薄的0.3。

segments.en: So I think the hawkish price actions may be taking the print a little bit too far.
segments.zh: 所以我认为鹰派的价格反应可能对这份数据解读得有点过头了。

segments.en: I mean, of course, the delayed market that's doing fine. But realistically, it's going to be the inflation data that are going to dictate what the Fed do.
segments.zh: 当然，延迟的市场表现良好。但现实地说，通胀数据将决定美联储的下一步行动。

segments.en: Yeah, does this have consequences or not for the committee meeting in a few weeks?
segments.zh: 是的，这对几周后的委员会会议有没有影响？

segments.en: I mean, at the margin, of course, it plays into the narrative and it confirms that delayed market is not something to worry about.
segments.zh: 当然，从边际上看，这确实影响了市场叙事，并确认了延迟降息无需担忧。

segments.en: Really, the next decision is going to be a question about does inflation end up coming in kind of below 0.3?
segments.zh: 实际上，下一个决定将取决于通胀率是否最终低于0.3%。

segments.en: And that's likely going to be the deciding factor here. Ultimately, this does represent, though, a good deal of strength that kind of supports the idea that the participation rate doesn't necessarily mean
segments.zh: 这很可能是决定性因素。不过，这确实显示出强劲的一面，支持了劳动力参与率并不一定意味着经济整体疲软的观点。

segments.en: that this is an overall weaker economy than maybe the 4.1% unemployment rate would suggest.
segments.zh: 这或许比4.1%的失业率所暗示的经济状况要好。

segments.en: Do you think that this does support the idea that policy is not restrictive?
segments.zh: 您认为这是否支持了政策并非紧缩的观点？

segments.en: If the labor market seems to be talking along, and if anything, breaking to the upside rather than to the downside?
segments.zh: 如果劳动力市场似乎保持稳定，甚至可能向上突破而非向下。

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, I think it's a signal that the labor market is in very good balance.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为这表明劳动力市场处于非常良好的平衡状态。
